name: DarkPad
notes: DarkPad owns its release recipe (darkpad-v...-padmint.json). Apple Silicon Mac builds a personal unsigned iPhone/iPad IPA; the player imports a Perfect Dark USA Rev 1 / v1.1 ROM in the app.

steps: Open DarkPad and choose your own Perfect Dark (USA) Rev 1 / v1.1 ROM from Files. Accepted formats: .z64, .v64 and .n64. The ROM is imported in the app, not used during the build.

Create or select an agent file, then choose Solo Missions to start. Use the ••• menu for display, touch controls and controller settings. Optional artwork and GoldenEye content are separate and are not included.
For updates, install over the existing app with the same signing setup to keep saves and settings. Deleting DarkPad deletes its local data.

off_mac.text: DarkPad has an experimental GitHub build for iPhone/iPad. Import PadMint into a private repository; a public fork cannot run this personal build. Private macOS builds use your account's Actions allowance. Follow the guide, then add your own Perfect Dark ROM inside DarkPad. A clean hosted build passed; installation and gameplay still need testing.

es.text: DarkPad tiene una compilación experimental de GitHub para iPhone/iPad. Importa PadMint en un repositorio privado; un fork público no puede ejecutar esta compilación personal. Las compilaciones privadas de macOS consumen la cuota de Actions de tu cuenta. Sigue la guía y añade tu propia ROM de Perfect Dark dentro de DarkPad. Una compilación limpia en GitHub terminó correctamente; la instalación y el juego aún necesitan pruebas.

pt.text: O DarkPad tem uma compilação experimental do GitHub para iPhone/iPad. Importe o PadMint para um repositório privado; um fork público não pode executar esta compilação pessoal.
